claims.supporting_quote: We found a coding mutation (A673T) in the APP gene that protects against Alzheimer's disease and cognitive decline in the elderly
claims.text: Whole-genome sequence data from 1,795 Icelanders identified a coding mutation in the APP gene, A673T, that protects against Alzheimer disease and against cognitive decline in elderly people without Alzheimer disease.

claims.supporting_quote: results in an approximately 40% reduction in the formation of amyloidogenic peptides in vitro
claims.text: The A673T substitution is adjacent to the beta-secretase cleavage site in APP and results in an approximately 40 percent reduction in the formation of amyloidogenic peptides in vitro, supporting the hypothesis that reducing beta-cleavage of APP may protect against Alzheimer disease.

claims.supporting_quote: The aspartyl protease beta-site amyloid precursor protein cleaving enzyme 1 (BACE1) is required for the production of Abeta
claims.text: BACE1, the beta-site amyloid precursor protein cleaving enzyme 1, is required for the production of amyloid-beta, and the BACE1 inhibitor verubecestat (MK-8931) reduced central nervous system amyloid-beta in animal models and in Alzheimer disease patients in early clinical studies.

forbidden_terms: did not reduce cognitive or functional decline
target: BACE1 (beta-site amyloid precursor protein cleaving enzyme 1)
